purpose: US 2.0 F2C read-only production preflight, used to design the cron migration. SELECT only through `supabase db query --linked` (Management API); no write. Names, versions and md5 digests only: no secret value, no command text.
queries: select extversion from pg_extension (pg_cron, pg_net, supabase_vault); current_user; session_user; cron.database_name; version()
select jobid, jobname, schedule, username, database, active, nodename, md5(command), length(command) from cron.job order by jobid
select pg_get_indexdef(indexrelid) from pg_index where indrelid = 'cron.job'::regclass
select name, created_at, updated_at from vault.secrets order by name
select proname, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(oid) from pg_proc where pronamespace = 'cron'::regnamespace
cron_job_unique_indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX job_pkey ON cron.job USING btree (jobid)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX jobname_username_uniq ON cron.job USING btree (jobname, username)
cron_functions: alter_job(job_id bigint, schedule text, command text, database text, username text, active boolean)
schedule(job_name text, schedule text, command text)
schedule_in_database(job_name text, schedule text, command text, database text, username text, active boolean)
findings: All seven commands are byte-identical (md5 and length) to the F2A.1 capture c09: no cron drift since F2A.1.
All seven jobs are owned by postgres, active, database postgres.

pg_cron keys jobs on (jobname, username): cron.schedule(name, ...) by another role would add a second job, so the migration updates existing jobs in place with cron.alter_job and refuses a foreign owner.
us_project_url is not provisioned yet: rollout step 2 must create it before the migration, which refuses to run otherwise.
